description: This file defines a React functional component named RecipeCard that displays a summary view of a recipe, including its cover image, title, author, servings, and cooking time. It imports React, React Router's Link, and a Button component, and exports the RecipeCard component for use elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: RecipeCard({ recipe })
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a recipe summary card with image, title, author, servings, and cook time, including a link to the detailed recipe page.
